releases.title: Fullscreen controls stay put on a skip
fixes: Fullscreen controls no longer vanish when you skip between two music videos - they stay on screen the whole time, like they do on a cover-to-cover skip
If a control fade is ever left stranded, a safety timer now restores it automatically instead of needing a fullscreen reopen

releases.title: A darker update notice
features: The update notice now matches the rest of the app: dark surface, white text and the same font as the panel
The Got it button is red instead of yellow
fixes: The notice is readable over a bright cover art again - the blurred artwork behind it was washing out the text

releases.title: Custom backgrounds and calmer fullscreen
features: Aurora Bloom can use your own image as the page background - warped with Kawarp or softly blurred, with brightness, saturation and contrast controls
Aurora Lyrics settings now live behind their own rail, grouped into Look, Words, Motion, Timing and Font instead of one long list
A Discord invite sits at the top of the add-on list
fixes: Fullscreen controls stay where they are - they no longer drift while a video or cover art loads
Cover art and music videos now hand over with a clean fade in both directions, and music video to music video leaves the controls alone
Switching between a cover art track and a music video no longer shows the wrong layout for a moment first
Uninstalling an add-on now asks you to restart YouTube Music, so no leftover code stays behind
The first-run tour has been removed - a fresh install goes straight to the app
The artist card in the Now Playing rail labels its subscriber count again

releases.title: Update notices
features: Aurora Lyrics now tells you what changed right after it updates
You will also be told when a newer version is available, with a link to the release

releases.title: Popup lyrics match the main panel
features: The popup now uses the same lyric size, settings, romanization and attribution as the main panel
Added a "Jump to current lyric" button that appears while you are scrolled away
Clicking a line in the popup seeks to that point in the track
fixes: The popup no longer snaps back to the active line while you are scrolling
Credits stay in the normal scroll flow instead of overlapping the last line
